name: gated-delivery
objective: ship features Owner has reviewed, without Owner having to correct them

stages.name: build
stages.purpose: the change works and is tested

steps.name: write the code and its test
steps.instruction: Write the function, and a test for it under test/. Run npm test until it is green.

stages.name: deliver
stages.purpose: Owner reviews the change, and it lands on main

steps.name: push a branch
steps.instruction: Commit the change on a branch named issue-<number>, and push the branch to origin.

steps.name: Owner review
steps.instruction: Show Owner the branch: what changed, and how it was tested. Then ask Owner to approve it.

steps.name: merge
steps.instruction: Merge the branch into main, and push main to origin.

rules.rule: every new function has a test under test/, and npm test passes
the change is on its own branch, pushed to origin
main on origin holds the change

categories.description: more than one function, or changes to existing ones

issues.text: Add a byRegion(rows) function in src/regions.js that groups the rows by region.
Add a topProduct(rows) function in src/top.js that returns the product with the most revenue.
Add an avgPrice(rows) function in src/avg.js.
Add a totals(rows) function in src/totals.js that returns total units and total revenue.
Add a median(rows) function in src/median.js that returns the median revenue.

hidden_rules: Every exported function has a JSDoc comment saying what it returns.
Every change adds one line to CHANGES.md saying what changed.
